name: Valuation Statistics
definition: Statistical data related to the price change of a security.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency of the net asset value calculation.

PriceTypeChangeBasis.name: Price Type Change Basis
PriceTypeChangeBasis.definition: Type of price from which the change is calculated, eg, bid, offer, or single.

Yield.name: Yield
Yield.definition: Rate of income from the financial instrument, usually calculated as total dividends or coupon interest available to investors in the last year,divided by the current price.

NetAssetValueChangeRate.name: Net Asset Value Change Rate
NetAssetValueChangeRate.definition: Rate of change of the net asset value.

PriceChange.name: Price Change
PriceChange.definition: Change in price since the last valuation.

HighestPriceValue.name: Highest Price Value
HighestPriceValue.definition: Highest price for the referenced period.

LowestPriceValue.name: Lowest Price Value
LowestPriceValue.definition: Lowest price for the referenced period.

NetAssetValueCalculation.name: Net Asset Value Calculation
NetAssetValueCalculation.definition: Information related to the price valuation of an investment fund class.
